nodes.label: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
nodes.author: Yoonho Lee, Roshen Nair, Qizheng Zhang, Kangwook Lee, Omar Khattab, Chelsea Finn
nodes.rationale: Proposes automated harness optimization via agentic search with full filesystem access to prior code, scores, and execution traces, enabling richer feedback than prior text optimizers.

nodes.label: Meta-Harness Search System
nodes.rationale: Core system that searches over harness code using a coding-agent proposer with filesystem-based access to prior candidates' source code, execution traces, and scores.

nodes.label: Coding Agent Proposer
nodes.rationale: Language-model-based agent (Claude Code with Opus-4.6) that inspects filesystem history and proposes new harnesses; key design choice is unrestricted access to prior experience rather than compressed summaries.

nodes.label: Filesystem-Based Experience Store
nodes.rationale: Central feedback mechanism storing all prior harness candidates' source code, execution traces, and evaluation scores; enables selective diagnosis rather than monolithic prompt assembly.

nodes.label: Online Text Classification Harness
nodes.rationale: Task-specific harness discovered by Meta-Harness for text classification; achieves 48.6% accuracy on USPTO/S2D/LawBench, outperforming ACE by 7.7 points while using 4× fewer context tokens.

nodes.label: Draft-Verification Classification Strategy
nodes.rationale: Discovered text classification harness using two-stage retrieval: draft prediction from 5 nearest examples, then verification against confirmers and challengers; low-context frontier point.

nodes.label: Label-Primed Query-Anchored Strategy
nodes.rationale: Discovered text classification harness using single larger call with label primer, coverage block (one example per label), and contrastive pairs; highest-accuracy frontier point.

nodes.label: Retrieval-Augmented Math Reasoning Harness
nodes.rationale: Discovered harness for IMO-level math problems using four-route BM25 retrieval (combinatorics, geometry, number theory, default); improves accuracy by 4.7 points on average across five held-out models.

nodes.label: TerminalBench-2 Agentic Coding Harness
nodes.rationale: Discovered harness for autonomous coding tasks; adds environment bootstrapping to Terminus-KIRA, achieving 76.4% pass rate on Opus 4.6 and 37.6% on Haiku 4.5, ranking #1 among Haiku agents.

nodes.label: Environment Bootstrapping Component
nodes.rationale: Key discovered modification for TerminalBench-2: gathers sandbox environment snapshot (OS, languages, package managers) before agent loop, eliminating 2-4 exploratory turns on dependency-heavy tasks.

nodes.label: OpenEvolve Text Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Prior text optimization method using evolutionary search with LLM mutations; operates with limited proposer inputs compared to Meta-Harness full filesystem access.

nodes.label: TTT-Discover Text Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Prior text optimization method using PUCT reuse rule for proposal selection; limited to window-based history and compressed feedback.

nodes.label: GEPA Reflective Prompt Evolution
nodes.rationale: Prior text optimization method providing rollout traces per candidate with reflective feedback; designed for short feedback loops, not long-horizon harness engineering.

nodes.label: Agentic Context Engineering (ACE)
nodes.rationale: Hand-designed baseline for text classification using reflective memory curation; achieves 40.9% accuracy on USPTO/S2D/LawBench with 50.8K context tokens.

nodes.label: Meta Context Engineering (MCE)
nodes.rationale: Hand-designed baseline for text classification maintaining and evolving library of natural-language skills; achieves 40.0% accuracy with 28.5K context tokens.

nodes.label: Credit Assignment and Meta-Learning
nodes.rationale: Broader literature on credit assignment and meta-learning; Meta-Harness assigns credit at harness level using experience from past rollouts to reason about failure modes.

nodes.label: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
nodes.rationale: Prior work on adaptive access to external context; Meta-Harness uses similar pattern but in more demanding setting of harness engineering with selective inspection of prior history.

nodes.label: Executable Code Search
nodes.rationale: Prior methods search over executable code for functions, workflows, or agent designs; Meta-Harness searches over domain-specific harnesses with unrestricted filesystem access.

nodes.label: Text Optimization Methods
nodes.rationale: Methods like ProTeGi, TextGrad, OPRO, GEPA, AlphaEvolve, Feedback Descent iteratively improve prompts using feedback; poorly matched to harness engineering due to compressed feedback.
